words.example: Household consumption fell when prices went up.

example_translations.ru: Потребление домохозяйств снизилось, когда цены выросли.
example_translations.uz: Narxlar oshganda uy xo'jaliklarining iste'moli kamaydi.

words.example: The city cut its expenditure on new roads.

example_translations.ru: Город сократил расходы на новые дороги.
example_translations.uz: Shahar yangi yo'llar uchun xarajatlarni qisqartirdi.

words.example: Repairing the old bridge proved too costly.

example_translations.ru: Ремонт старого моста оказался слишком дорогостоящим.
example_translations.uz: Eski ko'prikni ta'mirlash haddan tashqari serxarajat bo'lib chiqdi.

words.example: The store's revenue doubled during the holidays.

example_translations.uz: Bayram kunlarida do'konning tushumi ikki baravar oshdi.

words.example: Her monthly earnings are higher than mine.
He shared his wealth with schools and hospitals.

example_translations.ru: Он делился своим богатством со школами и больницами.
example_translations.uz: U o'z boyligini maktablar va shifoxonalar bilan baham ko'rdi.

words.example: The museum needs more funding to stay open.

example_translations.ru: Музею нужно дополнительное финансирование, чтобы продолжать работать.
example_translations.uz: Muzey ishlashda davom etishi uchun qo'shimcha moliyalashtirishga muhtoj.

words.example: A small car is more economical than a large one.
Our annual turnover reached two million dollars.

example_translations.ru: Наш годовой оборот достиг двух миллионов долларов.
example_translations.uz: Yillik aylanmamiz ikki million dollarga yetdi.

words.example: The cafe became profitable in its second year.

example_translations.ru: Кафе стало прибыльным на второй год работы.
example_translations.uz: Kafe ikkinchi yilida foyda keltiradigan bo'ldi.
